teaser: The Web Summit team, part two: seven people each with an agent, personal CRMs kept in sync, and every memo turned into a follow-up within the hour.
core_idea: The Web Summit team is the first we run with many humans, each bringing their own agent, so it is agents collaborating through their humans; that needs written roles and owners, a personal CRM in each person's vault synchronised into a team view by shared ids, a rule that anything recorded becomes a record, a page and a drafted follow-up within the hour while a person sends every email, a way of briefing scarce experts like a designer in their own medium, and a plan worked backwards from the summit's printing deadlines.
